description: This file contains unit tests for the ProgramWorkflowDAO class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing database operations such as saving and retrieving Program entities and ensuring proper behavior of the data access object.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowDAOTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ProgramWorkflowDAO methods, including saving, retrieving, and querying Program entities within the OpenMRS application. Extends BaseContextSensitiveTest to leverage the testing framework.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Setup method to initialize the DAO object before each test by fetching the bean from application context.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldSaveProgram
methods.description: Tests saving a Program object into the database.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate and set up a new Program object with default data.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldAlsoSaveOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Tests that setting the outcomes concept on a Program and saving persists the relationship correctly.

methods.name: getProgramsByName_whenThereAreNoProgramsWithTheGivenName_shouldReturnAnEmptyList
methods.description: Verifies that searching for a non-existent program name returns an empty list.

methods.name: getProgramsByName_whenThereAreProgramsWithTheGivenName_shouldReturnAllProgramsWithTheGivenName
methods.description: Verifies that multiple programs with the same name are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms_shouldReturnListChronologicallySortedByEnrollmentDate
methods.description: Tests that the retrieved list of PatientPrograms is sorted in chronological order.
